Global Verified Baggage Sharing Community

Global Logistics Human Powered

Connect with verified travelers carrying items between India and All Over the World. Safe, transparent, and 100% free.

Get Started FreeHow it Works

Our Philosophy

A Human Trust Network

Gulf Mitra is not a courier service. We are a platform that facilitates trust between individuals carrying items all over the world, city to city.

Verified Users Only

Safety first. Every member undergoes strict Government ID and Live Selfie verification.

Zero Platform Fees

Zero brokerage. Requesters and travelers coordinate directly with no hidden service charges.

OTP Verified Handover

Secure coordination. Real-time OTP validation for both pickup and handover stages.

Global Community

Worldwide connections. Tailored specifically for travelers and requesters looking to share costs globally.

The Process

Simplicity Meets Absolute Security.

01

Post a Request

Describe your item, weight, and destination to find the perfect traveler.

02

Search Trips

Browse verified travelers heading exactly where you need to send items.

03

Direct Connect

Chat with travelers. Match price and items with full transparency.

04

Safe Handover

Meet the traveler in a public place. Let them inspect the item securely.

05

Secure Delivery

Your item is delivered safely. Handover the OTP to complete the process.

06

Community Trust

Rate your experience and help build our global trust community.

Verification & Safety First

We prioritize your safety with strict verification and zero-tolerance policies.

Govt ID & Selfie

Mandatory Aadhaar/Passport and live selfie matching for every user.

Zero Tolerance

Strict bans for fake documents or suspicious activity. Action logs for your protection.

No Middlemen

Direct, free connections with verified peers. Zero platform fees.

#1 Trusted Gulf-India Shipping Alternative

Gulf Mitra is revolutionizing how people send items between Gulf countries and India. By connecting you with verified travelers, we offer a secure, fast, and affordable way to send documents, gifts, and electronics.

Major Shipping Corridors & Routes

UAE 🇦🇪

• Dubai to Mumbai

• Abu Dhabi to Kochi

• Sharjah to Chennai

Qatar 🇶🇦

• Doha to Kerala

• Doha to Delhi

• Doha to Hyderabad

Saudi Arabia 🇸🇦

• Riyadh to Mumbai

• Jeddah to Bangalore

• Dammam to Kochi

Oman & Others 🇴🇲

• Muscat to Kochi

• Kuwait to Mumbai

• Bahrain to India

Smart, Privacy-First Matching

Gulf Mitra connects you with nearby verified users using privacy-safe, area-level location matching — similar to how ride-hailing apps find drivers near you.

  • No exact live tracking visible to others
  • Area-level visibility only (e.g., "Nearby in Downtown")
  • User privacy is fully protected
